cohort: 45 pregnant women with chronic migraine receiving onabotulinumtoxinA treatment at the Hull Headache Clinic over a 9-year period
finding: This study of 45 pregnant women exposed to onabotulinumtoxinA found no significant negative impact on pregnancy outcomes, including miscarriage rate, birth weight, or congenital malformations, although the sample size was small.
mod_finding: The study reports on pregnancy outcomes of women exposed to onabotulinumtoxinA during pregnancy, finding no significant impact on mode of delivery, birth weight, or congenital malformations.
